interpretation.got: Late engine time is high and command thread repeatedly waits. Texture-preparation intervals include GPU waits and may include driver work; not proven shader-only or CPU-binding-only cost.
interpretation.gow: Low owned GPU engine use plus a busy GPU command thread indicate substantial CPU/serialization overhead. Millions of page-protection changes and thousands of ordered compute readbacks are candidates pending timing attribution.
interpretation.vram: No model containers found; no attribution to Ollama or capacity exhaustion.
interpretation.regression_claim: 4 vs prior 9 FPS GoT overlays are not a controlled before/after performance comparison. Newly rendered work, scenes and recording costs differ. No FPS gain or unique regression cause claimed.

measurement_limits: Engine occupancy is the delta of owned DRM client gfx nanoseconds divided by elapsed wall time, not global GPU busy and not shader execution time.
Process CPU uses Linux x86 USER_HZ=100; thread CPU uses schedstat nanoseconds directly. Thread snapshot windows are approximately 140 to 180 seconds.
GPU command ring stores CPU-side markers. Adjacent marker gaps cannot be assigned to a specific completed GPU draw or a pure CPU function.
Graphics diagnostic counts are exponentially sampled lower bounds, not exact total calls.
Timing counters and SIGPROF sampling were disabled in this capture. Prior build profiles cannot establish current costs after rendering-path changes.
Live counters are asynchronous snapshots; nested self time and sample distributions need to be interpreted alongside waits, not naively summed across threads.
remaining_rendering_blockers: GoT seven rejected 536-byte material-record tables have zero guest num_records; preserve real extents, never invent bounds.
GoT dynamic descriptor provenance warnings remain alongside newly accepted indexed material paths.
GoT large typed descriptor arrays (including 1755 and roughly 27904 slots) and per-entry sampler lookups deserve timing evidence.
Unsupported numeric image formats and library stubs remain; no evidence that every warning is a rendering cause.
GoW black surfaces remain despite user-reported cutscene passage. Ordered GDS semantics, coherent readbacks and correct VCC behavior must be retained.

runner_change.behavior: Capture the existing live CPU samples and timing counters at 140 and 180 seconds in addition to 80 and 110 when performance diagnostics are enabled. No emulator rebuild or emulation change.
